articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Nov. 19, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, is pleased to invite investors to a webinar on December 9, 2025, at 4:15 p.m. ET. The exclusive event, hosted by RedChip Companies, will feature Cuong Do, President and CEO of BioVie, who will discuss bezisterim (NE3107), BioVie’s first-in-class, orally available small molecule that targets inflammation and insulin resistance, two key drivers of Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and Long COVID, where it has shown encouraging signals of improved cognition, motor function, and reduced neuroinflammation across clinical studies. He will also outline progress with BIV201, BioVie’s late-stage orphan drug candidate for refractory ascites, a life-threatening complication of liver cirrhosis with no FDA-approved therapies.
